chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi takes Gu Suizhou to the Underground City to show him his workplace, W.N headquarters, revealing he works there as a cleaning supervisor under the name 'Shen Zhi'. Gu Suizhou, still suspicious, visits his friend Leapton (Guinness Dan Leapton) at an internet cafe to investigate Shen Feizhi. Shen Feizhi arrives, and it is revealed that Leapton is a significant character from the original plot—a future victim of Pheromone Dysregulation Syndrome. Shen Feizhi warns Gu Suizhou against investigating him and reveals his connection to the powerful 'Shen family' before returning to work.
